SPACE X REVENUE / ARR
• Tracking in excess of $100B annualized by December 2026

STARLINK 
• 10× the capability of V3 (V3 itself was already ~10× V2), especially long-distance laser links
• Next-gen laser links: 10 terabits per second each (100× better)
• 10 laser links per satellite

STARSHIP FLIGHT 15
• Will attempt to catch both the Super Heavy booster and the Starship upper stage
• If successful → first time all parts of an orbital rocket return intact
• “Largest flying object ever made… you really want to watch this one”

TERAFAB (AI CHIP FACTORY)
• Built in phases (trillion-scale over time, capital not needed all upfront)
• Research fab at Giga Texas, Austin
• Main production site: Grimes County, Texas (near Texas A&M / Gibbons Creek area)
• Scale target: roughly 30× next year’s entire global AI chip output

SPACE COMPUTE / STARMIND
• Computers co-designed with NVIDIA; first satellites ~Q3 2027
• Ramp in 2028, very large volume in 2029
• NVIDIA GPU and Google TPU satellites already “working fine in space”
• Earth power grid cannot support ~200 GW/year of AI growth (~40% of the entire US grid every year — not feasible)
• Space advantage: ~30% more solar power (no atmospheric attenuation)

TESLA
• Winding down Cybertruck production at Giga Texas around mid-2027
• Freeing capacity for much higher Cybercab / robotaxi production
• Model Y is the best-selling EV in China

HANDS-ON LEADERSHIP (MEMPHIS POWER PLANT / DATA CENTER)
• Power plant built in ~1 year instead of the usual ~5 years
• Elon walks the full site 2–5 times a day
• Does physical work himself (pulling anaconda-sized power cables, fiber, electrical, software)
• “I try to do a little of everything so I’m not numb to the pain of the people who are actually doing it”

OTHER HIGHLIGHTS
• SpaceX + Tesla = two best physical hardware companies on Earth outside China
• Data centers bring real local prosperity (Memphis: full restaurants/hotels, ~2× wages, higher tax revenue, school support) — opposition is temporary
• Spectrum: SpaceX can get very far with what it has acquired; could buy a legacy telco and use the spectrum ~10× more effectively
• Timeline style: aims for 50th-percentile accuracy (press mostly reports only the late ones)
